items.title: The smartest way to cut AI costs isn’t to use less AI
items.summary: A survey of 1,000+ knowledge workers shows AI’s true costs are coming into focus. The takeaway for leaders: the path to lower spend runs through better context, visibility, and tool choice, not tighter limits.The post The smartest way to cut AI costs isn’t to use less AI appeared first on Inside Atlassian.
items.creator: esarasohn
